recognize_zh: 中央的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）核呈濃縮、分葉少的雙葉或圓形團塊，細胞質深藍且邊緣呈毛邊狀，在化療後骨髓中屬於巨核細胞的治療相關變化。
features: Megakaryocyte with a dense, hyperchromatic, hypolobated (round to bilobed) nucleus
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with ragged, frayed margins and scant granulation
Cell smaller than a typical mature megakaryocyte, but much larger than surrounding myeloid cells
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and scattered erythroid precursors
Occasional cell with coarse cytoplasmic vacuolization in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a compact, hyperchromatic, hypolobated nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular, frayed borders. The background contains maturing granulocytic precursors and occasional erythroid precursors without an increase in blasts in this field. In the setting of recent cytotoxic therapy, these megakaryocytic changes are most consistent with chemotherapy effect; true dysplasia should not be diagnosed on post-therapy marrow without clinical correlation.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia persists without recent therapy and is accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and often cytopenias with clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.
The 5q- syndrome shows numerous small monolobated megakaryocytes with isolated del(5q), whereas this change is a transient post-chemotherapy effect.
Megakaryoblasts have fine blastic chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs, unlike the condensed mature chromatin of this megakaryocyte.
